text:
Sophie (CSM): FYI — multiple onboarding customers reported embedding failures and increased 5xxs since 09:12 PT. I pulled a quick list of impacted accounts. Need a customer-facing status + RCA draft.
Jon (Eng/SRE): Investigating. Appears related to a recent model routing change + a cache eviction bug. Rolling back the routing change now.
incident-bot: [1769876600] Incident created: EMB-503 - Embeddings pipeline errors affecting subset of customers. Status: investigating. Link: https://incidents.redwood/EMB-503
Mike (Support): Affected customers I see in Zendesk tags: acme-corp, finlytics, edu-green. All are in onboarding or early trial.
Tom (AE): Heads up — ACME and Finlytics are mid-renewal pipeline (renewal Q2). Need careful wording, offer technical support session.
Sophie (CSM): Agreed. Drafting a short status email we can send now and then an RCA follow-up. Please chime on wording.
Sophie (CSM): ``
Subject: Incident impacting embeddings — short status update
Hi <Customer>,
We’re investigating an issue causing errors and delays for embeddings requests. Our engineers are rolling back a recent routing change and we expect restoration within the hour. We’ll follow up with a root cause analysis and any mitigation steps.
If you need immediate assistance or want a dedicated call, reply and we’ll schedule.
— Sophie, Customer Success
``
Jon (Eng/SRE): Can we add a short technical note: rollback of routing config applied at 09:28 PT, rolling back KV cache eviction flag; initial service recovery observed 09:41 PT for ~70% of traffic.
Sophie (CSM): Added. New draft below.
Sophie (CSM): ``
Subject: Update: embeddings incident — service partially restored
Hi <Customer>,
An engineering rollback was applied at 09:28 PT to a recent routing/config change that interacted badly with the KV cache eviction behavior. We’ve seen partial restoration (about 70%) starting 09:41 PT and are monitoring. We’ll send an RCA once confirmed.
If you rely on onboarding pipelines today and want a standby engineer on a call, we can set that up.
— Sophie (Redwood CSM)
``
Maria (Solutions): Suggest adding an optional enablement offer: 30-min onboarding sync to re-run embeddings and confirm pipelines. That will help reduce churn risk.
Tom (AE): Please include that offer in the message to ACME/Finlytics specifically. Also propose a credit for trial customers impacted.
Mike (Support): I’ll queue a support-flagged priority for the impacted tickets and include the email draft when I reach out.
Jon (Eng/SRE): Post-rollback health check looks good for most routes. I’m running a targeted replay for ACME dataset now. ETA for full recovery 30–45 mins.
Sophie (CSM): Ok — sending the update to impacted customers now (ACME/Finlytics/EduGreen). Copying the team.
Sophie (CSM): Sent email to affected contacts, and offered remediation call + 15% trial credit.
Tom (AE): Thanks. I’ll follow up with ACME lead and offer a dedicated postmortem call if they want it.
incident-bot: [1769878200] Incident update: EMB-503 - mitigation in progress, partial recovery.
Jon (Eng/SRE): Root cause provisional: a routing change that altered shard assignment combined with aggressive KV cache eviction on certain hosts, causing a higher 5xx rate for warm-up traffic. Fix: revert routing change + adjust eviction threshold; longer-term: add canary + predeploy tests for routing vs cache interplay.
Sophie (CSM): When we have the final RCA and timeline, I’ll prepare a customer-facing postmortem. Need suggestions: short version for customers (2–3 bullets) and a technical appendix if they want details.
Maria (Solutions): Recommend we capture feedback after remediation: 1) Did the remediation restore onboarding pipelines? 2) Any data loss or duplicate items? 3) Are they ok with the proposed compensations (credit + enablement)? I can field those in follow-up calls.
Mike (Support): I’ll add those three questions to the support tickets and set a reminder for 48h follow-up.
Sophie (CSM): Final note to team: prioritize ACME/Finlytics for follow-up enablement and document the compensation in Gainsight/CRM. Also flag renewal risk for finance ops.
Tom (AE): Marked. I’ll update the opportunity notes and reach out to the finance lead if we need approval for extended credits.
Sophie (CSM): Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open — will post the customer-facing RCA when ready. :thumbsup:
